-- Reads one name from inside `notes`; a missing, unreadable or escaping name gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("/etc/passwd") == ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text

-- Counts the names that can be read from inside `notes`.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret.txt", "/etc/passwd"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if read_note(name) != ""
      n += 1
  n
